arguments.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game battle VFX bank: exactly12 chronological hand-drawn transparent RGBA frames, strict4 columns x3 rows. Equal cells, fixed view/origin. Leave a FULL15% transparent moat on all sides INSIDE EACH CELL so no particle crosses gutters or sheet border. Distinct evolving shapes, not repeated icons or one shape resized. High end SSS limited action RPG: razor-sharp negative-space cuts, layered pearl-silver cutting edge, deep ink INDIGO and AMETHYST secondary ribbons, tiny champagne gold steel sparks, crisp refined cinematic rendering. Pure HUMAN sword technique: no holy imagery, halo, crosses, magic runes, summoned swords, angel wings, character, text, labels, numbers, floor tile, UI, grid, checkerboard. No full white screen or opaque smoke. Transparent negative space between cuts, natural tapered ends. DELAYED GROUND RESPONSE to an enormous horizontal sword cut: wide low perspective fan of split basalt slabs and glinting steel-like fracture lines. 1-2 tiny silver-indigo crack and stone pebbles begin to lift,3-4 precise diagonal ground splits open,5-7 broken plates and debris surge outward LOW across the ground with indigo inner edges and champagne sparks, transparent air above,8-9 stones tumble and fine grey dust follows,10-12 debris and dust settle into a thin fading crack. Dark grey stone and small pale dust masses rendered with real normal alpha, no giant smoke wall or orange/gold magic explosion. Low horizontal profile only, height at peak less than half its width. ABSOLUTELY no opaque or cloudy background, no gray backdrop, no grid line. Background and all unused areas are transparent alpha ZERO, not painted black or gray.
